definitions.explanation: Indicates that a registration process has been completed. Used for accounts, products, documents, and any official registration. Functions as a no-adjective to modify nouns.

examples.japanese: {登録済|とうろくず}みのアカウント。
この{商品|しょうひん}は{商標|しょうひょう}{登録済|とうろくず}みです。
{会員|かいいん}{登録済|とうろくず}みの{方|かた}は、ログインしてください。
examples.english: If you have already completed member registration, please log in.

examples.japanese: {住所|じゅうしょ}{変更|へんこう}の{届|とど}け{出|で}は{登録済|とうろくず}みですので、ご{安心|あんしん}ください。
examples.english: The address change notification has been registered, so please rest assured.

notes:
Compound of {登録|とうろく} (registration) + {済|す}み (completed). The suffix {済|す}み attaches to nouns (especially suru-verb stems) to indicate that the action has been finished. This pattern is extremely productive:
- {確認|かくにん}{済|す}み: confirmed/verified
- {支払|しはら}い{済|す}み: paid
- {完了|かんりょう}{済|す}み: completed
- {予約|よやく}{済|す}み: reserved/booked

Very common in business, administrative, and digital contexts (websites, apps, forms).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {登録済|とうろくず}みの{住所|じゅうしょ}: registered address
- {登録済|とうろくず}みのメールアドレス: registered email address
- {商標|しょうひょう}{登録済|とうろくず}み: trademark registered

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {登録|とうろく}{完了|かんりょう}: registration complete — more explicit phrasing, common in system messages
- {届出|とどけで}{済|す}み: notification filed — similar pattern with a different action
